title: Auto Loans: how often and how far the due day may move
content:
# Auto Loans: how often and how far the due day may move

This quick reference gives, for each Auto Loans product at PCB, the number of due date changes allowed in any rolling 365 days and the largest move of the monthly due day, in calendar days.

| Auto Loans product | Due date changes allowed in any rolling 365 days | Largest move of the due day (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|
| Used Vehicle Loan | 1 | 15 |
| Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Loan | 1 | 15 |
| Auto Refinance Loan | 1 | 15 |
| Lease Buyout Loan | 1 | 15 |
| New Vehicle Loan | 1 | 15 |
| Green Vehicle Loan | 1 | 15 |

Both settings are whole numbers and are the same on all six products.

## Illustration (hypothetical due days)

| Current due day | Requested due day | Size of the move | Within the largest move of 15 days? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5 | 20 | 15 days later | yes, equal to the limit |
| 5 | 21 | 16 days later | no |
| 25 | 10 | 15 days earlier | yes, equal to the limit |
